text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That was... how old was I back then?
I remember biting into a rose seed once.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Would it carry a sweet fragrance?
Would it carry a fleeting scent?
I waited with high hopes, but—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Tasteless and odorless. It was surprisingly bland—
a complete disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is unlikely that the seed has sprouted just now, yet...
Ugh, my head... feels as though a thorn is piercing through it.

Rose Kingdom found herself plagued
by headaches of unknown origin.
